genesis.authentication.flow.privacyNotic:
To make your lights react to Spotify music, we receive information about the song you're currently playing in the Spotify app. We also receive device-specific data to show which device you're using to play music.

When you select a new song, the previous song's device and song data is overwritten. When you unlink your Hue and Spotify accounts, all Spotify data is deleted from your Hue system.
